verified_facts.text: Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites sits on ochre cliffs above the Atlantic, close to Praia da Falesia, with direct access from the resort to the beach via a private lift.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched above the Atlantic on dramatic ochre cliffs, Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites is just moments from Praia da Falésia, one of the most striking beaches in the Algarve, with direct access from the resort via a private lift.

verified_facts.text: The resort is at Praia da Falesia, Pinhal do Concelho, in Albufeira, Portugal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Praia Da Falésia, Pinhal do Concelho, Albufeira, Portugal, 8200-593

verified_facts.text: The resort has modern architecture and a contemporary style, set among historic gardens and ochre cliffs crowned with pine trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: Defined by modern architecture and vibrant contemporary style, our family resort in the Algarve is seamlessly integrated into the surrounding natural landscape, where historic gardens meet ochre cliffs crowned with pine trees.

verified_facts.text: Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites is located at the heart of the Pine Cliffs resort and is home to the Serenity Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: it is ideally located at the heart of the resort and home to the award-winning Serenity Spa

verified_facts.text: Accommodation ranges from suites to one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, all with private balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: ranging from suites to one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, all with private balconies

verified_facts.text: The suites have fully equipped kitchens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Algarve accommodation offers luxury suites with fully-equipped kitchens.

verified_facts.text: The bedroom suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and en-suite bathrooms with a rainfall shower and custom-blended amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxury bedroom suites offer plush beds, floor-to-ceiling windows for abundant natural light, and spacious en-suite bathrooms with a luxurious rainfall shower and custom-blended amenities.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has two bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, a jacuzzi and an expansive terrace with sunbeds and an open-air dining area.
verified_facts.excerpt: a fully-equipped kitchen, a jacuzzi and an expansive terrace with delicious sunbeds and an open-air dining area

verified_facts.text: Guests can use butler service and The Luxury Collection Concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a 5-star experience in Portugal with Butler Service and The Luxury Collection Concierge

verified_facts.text: The Serenity Spa's Thermal Oasis has a hydrotherapy pool, Himalayan salt sauna, herbal sauna, steam room, Kneipp therapy pool, ice fountain and outdoor Jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Serenity Thermal Oasis, featuring a hydrotherapy pool, Himalayan salt sauna, herbal sauna, steam room, Kneipp therapy pool, ice fountain, outdoor Jacuzzi, and serene relaxation areas.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatment spaces include the Japanese-inspired Sakura room, a hydrotherapy bath and a marble hammam.
verified_facts.excerpt: such as the Japanese-inspired Sakura room, Hydrotherapy bath, and marble Hammam

verified_facts.text: The spa's private Serenity Aurum Suite has a steam room, sauna, Jacuzzi, experience shower and a double treatment room for couples or friends.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Serenity Aurum Suite provides a luxurious setting with a steam room, sauna, Jacuzzi, experience shower, and a double treatment room for couples or friends.

verified_facts.text: The spa's signature treatment uses traditional Algarve ingredients such as fleur-de-sel from Ria Formosa, sand from Falesia Beach, carob and orange oil.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover our Signature Treatment with the most traditional ingredients of the Algarve, like fleur-de-sel from Ria Formosa, sand from Falésia Beach, carob and orange oil.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is home to the Pine Cliffs golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: Home to the Pine Cliffs golf course, Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Algarve is the ideal hotel for Portugal golf getaways.

verified_facts.text: The Pine Cliffs Golf Course is a 9-hole course set along the cliffs with views of the Atlantic, designed by architect Martin Hawtree.
verified_facts.excerpt: An impeccably maintained, superb 9-hole course perched 200 feet above the crystal-clear waters of the Atlantic. Designed by architect Martin Hawtree

verified_facts.text: The course's signature hole, the Devil's Parlour, has a tee shot over the top of the cliff to a large undulating green.
verified_facts.excerpt: 'The Devils Parlour' is the signature hole of the course, with a challenging tee shot long over the top of the cliff to a large undulating green.

verified_facts.text: The Porto Pirata playground has bouncy castles, a basketball court, two swimming pools for kids, a mini golf course and two life-size pirate ships.
verified_facts.excerpt: bouncy castles, a basketball court, two kids-only swimming pools, a mini golf course and two life-size pirate ships

verified_facts.text: Tennis and padel are offered at the Annabel Croft Tennis Academy, with expert coaching and tailored programs.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the Annabel Croft Tennis Academy, guests can choose from four world-class tennis courts (two clay and two hard courts) and four state-of-the-art padel courts, complemented by expert coaching and tailored programs.

verified_facts.text: The heated indoor pool has direct access from the gym and offers swimming programs for all levels and ages.
verified_facts.excerpt: The heated indoor pool, with direct access from the gym, offers personalized swimming programs for all levels and ages.

verified_facts.text: The Head of Concierge designed two weekly Destination Discoveries: a Tiles Tour and a Botanical Tour.
verified_facts.excerpt: transformed it into two Destination Discoveries moments designed by our Head of Concierge. The discoveries happen weekly

verified_facts.text: Boat excursions sail the Algarve coastline on a catamaran, including the Benagil Cave, which is explored on a smaller boat.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set sail along the Algarve coastline on a catamaran and discover its hidden beauty, including the iconic Benagil Cave, which is explored on a smaller boat.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can arrange dining reservations, a tennis court or a bespoke excursion.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether you need a reservation for a special dining experience, a tennis court, or a bespoke excursion, our concierge can make it happen.

verified_facts.text: Mirador Champagne Bar sits above the Atlantic, serving champagne at sunset and signature cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched above the Atlantic, Mirador is an iconic setting for champagne at sunset and signature cocktails.

verified_facts.text: Mare is a contemporary beach restaurant steps from the ocean, serving freshly caught fish and seafood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Steps from the ocean, Maré is a contemporary beach restaurant where the flavours of the Atlantic take centre stage, with freshly caught fish and seafood

verified_facts.text: Water sports such as jet-ski, kayak and stand up paddle are provided at Falesia Beach during the summer.
verified_facts.excerpt: During the summer we provide several water sports activities at Falesia Beach. From jet-ski, kayak, stand up paddle, banana ride, pedal boat and many others.

verified_facts.text: The closest airport is Faro Airport, approximately 35 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest airport near Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Algarve is Faro Airport (FAO). FAO is located approximately 35.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The rooms do not permit rollaway beds.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, the rooms at Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Algarve do not permit rollaway beds.

verified_facts.text: A facility fee is added to all stays; it cannot be paid with points and must be paid at check-in.
verified_facts.excerpt: A facility fee will be added to all stays; you cannot pay with points and must be paid upon check-in.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Algarve.
